description: Check which of the files and signals AI agents look for a site publishes: llms.txt and llms-full.txt, a Markdown answer to `Accept: text/markdown`, an MCP server card, an API catalog, an OpenAPI document, an agent skills index, Content Signals and AI crawler rules in robots.txt, and DNS-AID records — each check pass / improve / fix with how to fix it. Missing API files are improvements, not failures, for a site with no API. It requests each well-known file once as our crawler (MakerRadarBot), after robots.txt, and stores nothing. at most 20 checks an hour per network and 30 an hour per site checked.

url.description: The site to check (https://example.com). Any URL on it means its whole site.

name: check_agent_readiness

checks.description: Fails first. `fix` is the one action to take; null on a pass.

facts.description: What was read, as labelled rows. From the site or a registry: unverified.

listing.description: Whether the site is listed on the directory: its page when it is (and claimUrl while nobody has proven they own it), where to list it when not.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a page on the site.
